verdict.rationale: Oneleet serves downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.3 documents at its API origin for both the Public API (157 paths) and the Auditor API (25 paths), and its docs link them directly for import into Postman or client generation. The probe 404s were on docs.oneleet.com paths, a different host, so they do not contradict a spec served at api.oneleet.com. missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of the spec's completeness and use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Oneleet serves a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.3 document for its Public API (157 paths) at the API origin
